images.title: Guess a hidden value from its neighbours
images.purpose: Shows Karnataka's hidden value surrounded by its five neighbours' values, so the child can see it should lean to rice.
images.composition: Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no characters, no extra text. One central circle with five smaller circles around it, placed roughly where the neighbours lie on a map, joined to the centre by short lines.
images.exact_structure: A large central circle with a thick reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline labelled Karnataka ? Around it, five smaller circles joined to it by short grey (#6B7280) lines: above it Maharashtra −15, filled light vermilion (#D55E00) for wheat; upper left Goa +57, lower left Kerala +79, lower right Tamil Nadu +85, right Andhra Pradesh +92, these four filled light teal (#0072B2) for rice. Under the picture, one line: estimate about +60 to +80. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Four of five neighbours lean strongly to rice, so Karnataka probably does too, about +60 to +80.
images.description: Shows Karnataka's hidden value surrounded by its five neighbours' values, so the child can see it should lean to rice.
images.context: Neighbour mean (57 + 79 + 85 + 92 − 15) / 5 = 59.6; the estimate is a range, not an exact answer.

image_decisions.why: A hidden state circled by its neighbours' values makes estimating from neighbours a single glance.
